result.stdout:
andy-ck — ask the Andy Computable Knowledge engine a question

  andy-ck [options] "<question>" ["<question>" ...]

  -f, --format <markdown|json|html>   how to render the answer (default markdown)
  -l, --list                          list the question forms and vocabulary
  -h, --help                          this message

Exit codes: 0 answered, 1 no question given, 2 a question could not be answered.
